textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 7 english · My Dear Soldiers · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: The poet addresses the defenders of the borders and calls them great sons of the motherland. While the rest of us sleep, they keep doing their duty.

beats.en: The poet addresses the defenders of the borders and calls them great sons of the motherland. While the rest of us sleep, they keep doing their duty.
beats.speakEn: The poet addresses the defenders of the borders and calls them great sons of the motherland. While the rest of us sleep, they keep doing their duty.

beats.en: The theme is patriotism and sacrifice. The tone is grateful, respectful and prayerful. Imagery appears in windy season, snowy days and scorching sun, which let us picture the hardships.
